author: NorthEast News Desk
body: The Peach Cobbler Factory has opened its first New England location at 102 Dean Street in Providence, bringing the fast-growing Southern-dessert chain to the edge of Federal Hill.

NBC 10 WJAR reported Tuesday that the location is one of more than 120 nationwide. Its menu includes warm cobblers, banana puddings, cinnamon rolls, brownies, cookies, milkshakes and ice cream, with four-item dessert flights for customers who want smaller portions of several selections.

The Providence shop is open from noon to 10 p.m. Sunday through Tuesday, noon to midnight Wednesday and Thursday, and noon to 2:30 a.m. Friday and Saturday, according to the company’s location page. Delivery and catering are also advertised.

The opening adds a nationally known sweets brand to a neighborhood best known for independent restaurants and Italian food. Early customer traffic will show whether social-media recognition translates into repeat local business after the novelty period. The company has not disclosed hiring totals or projected sales for the Providence franchise.
dek: The Southern-dessert chain has opened near Federal Hill with cobblers, banana pudding, cinnamon rolls and late-night weekend hours.
headline: Peach Cobbler Factory opens first New England shop in Providence
